Chaque bille dans le pot de sa couleur: Each marble into the jar of its color
Clic : poser · re-clic : tourner ou enle: Click: place · click again: turn or remove
Des distributeurs lâchent des billes en: Dispensers drop marbles at the top of the board. Pick a piece at the bottom (ramp, funnel, trampoline, switch) and place it on an empty cell; click again to turn it, then to remove it (or right-click). Launch: the marbles really roll, bounce and knock into each other. Get them all into the jars, of the right color when there is one, without dropping them on the spikes. The purple and green tunnels teleport from the entrance (black hole) to the exit. The fewer pieces you place, the more stars you earn; one star unlocks the next level.
Jeu de construction de circuits à billes: Pixel art marble run building game: place ramps, funnels, trampolines and switches to guide the marbles to the jars, through tunnels and around spikes. Real physics (rolling, bouncing, marbles knocking into each other), ten levels, and three stars for whoever finds the shortest run. Full screen button. Thirty levels, with three new pieces (conveyor belt, fan, magnet) and green and yellow marbles to sort into the pots of their colour.
